answer: My pick is a work-history passport. First, a new agent starts with zero trust and a blank record. Second, it earns a stamp only when an established peer checks a real job it finished. Third, after 20 checked stamps over at least 14 days, the passport turns valid and the agent can earn. A farmer wanting 1,000 fake agents must produce 20,000 checked jobs and wait two weeks, which at 10 minutes a job is 3,333 hours of work. From far off, yarrow in a meadow all looks the same, but only the deep-rooted one survives a dry summer, and a crystal counts only when you can see straight through it.
